errors.BAD_REQUEST: The request could not be understood. Please check it and try again.
errors.INVALID_OTP: That code is not correct. Please check it and try again.
errors.OTP_EXPIRED: This code has expired or was tried too many times. Please request a new one.
errors.INVALID_INVITE_CODE: This invite code is not valid. Please check it with your family admin.

errors.ALREADY_IN_FAMILY: You are already part of a family.

errors.LAST_ADMIN: The family needs at least one admin. Make someone else an admin first.
errors.SOS_NOT_ACTIVE: This SOS alert is no longer active.
errors.CONFLICT: This conflicts with existing data. Please refresh and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some of the information is missing or invalid.
errors.GUARDIAN_CONSENT_REQUIRED: A parent or guardian must give consent to add a member of this age.

errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: This service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
